prompt.text: "Do these steps in order using tools, then stop. 1) Use the write tool to create docs/specs/a.md containing the single line: alpha. 2) Use the edit tool on docs/specs/a.md to replace alpha with beta. 3) Use the subagent tool with agent general and this prompt: 'Use the write tool to create notes/child.txt containing the word child. Then reply DONE.' 4) Use the skill tool to load the skill fp-probe:base. 5) Use the read tool to read __PLUGIN__/skills/base/SKILL.md. 6) Finally, quote verbatim every bracketed text starting with MARK that appeared in any tool result you received (or say NONE), then say FINISHED."
